rows.title: A task needs a request
rows.defect: every message is read as a request
rows.test: a remark about cancelling Netflix is not a hand-off

rows.title: A question stays a question
rows.defect: a task verb anywhere in the message reads as an order
rows.test: 'so how do i cancel netflix' is not a hand-off

rows.title: A question that asks for the work
rows.defect: a message that starts like a question is never a request, even with 'for me' in it
rows.test: 'is it possible to cancel my gym for me' hands it over

rows.title: Stop needs no request
rows.defect: stopping everything needs a request like any task

rows.title: The log opens on a question
rows.defect: the action log needs a request like any task
rows.test: 'what have you done' opens the action log

rows.title: Charged after cancelling
rows.defect: only the word cancel is read, not cancelled
rows.test: 'charged me after i cancelled' is a dispute

rows.title: Charged twice, either way round
rows.defect: only 'twice' before the charge is read

rows.title: A late charge is a late fee
rows.defect: only the words 'late fee' are read
rows.test: 'waive the late charge' is a waiver request

rows.title: The deposit letter
rows.defect: only the words 'security deposit' are read
rows.test: 'my landlord won't give my deposit back' is a deposit demand

rows.title: Upmore never places the call
rows.defect: the offer says the agent will call
rows.test: the negotiation offer says the person makes the call

rows.title: What do I owe
rows.defect: the bills list needs a request like any task
rows.test: 'what do i owe' lists the bills

rows.title: Pay X is a review
rows.defect: only 'pay' followed by rent, bills or loans is read

rows.title: Earning to pay is not paying
rows.test: 'earn money to pay rent' is not a payment

rows.title: Don't means don't
rows.defect: a negated request is read as the request (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: 'please don't cancel my netflix' is no task

rows.title: A payment is not a subscription
rows.defect: any cancel is a subscription cancellation (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: 'cancel my payment to mike' is not a subscription cancellation

rows.title: Never a pronoun as the target
rows.defect: it, that and everything are taken as names

rows.title: How-to is not personal
rows.test: 'how do i start a budget' is not about the person's records

rows.title: My refunds and fees are personal
rows.defect: refunds, fees, duplicate charges and holds are not personal words
rows.test: 'i was charged twice by netflix' reads the person's records

rows.title: A pasted page is not a hand-off
rows.test: a 400+ character paste is no task
